about: Lines of the extension's copy whose words are the released extension's own (the 0.30.0 line), marked "Approved wording (the released extension's own words)". A line listed here whose words change is a new sentence: turn it back into a placeholder and take it off this list.

ACCOUNT_KEYS_DAMAGED.text: This account's stored keys are damaged or from a newer version, so sign-in cannot continue. Contact your admin or restore from a backup.

APP_NOT_REACHED.text: Couldn’t reach the andvari app. Open it once, then try again.

APP_SERVER_NONE.text: Choose your server in the andvari app. This extension uses the same one.

APP_SERVER_UNKNOWN.text: andvari couldn’t ask the andvari app which server you use. Open the app once, then open this again.

BACKEND_NOT_RESPONDING.text: Extension backend not responding — try reloading the extension.

BAD_WIRE_ID.text: The server sent a malformed account record, so sign-in was stopped. Tell your admin — the server may be misbehaving.

BIO_SETUP_CANCELLED.text: Setup was cancelled — try again when you're ready.

BIO_UNLOCK_CANCELLED.text: Device unlock was cancelled — try again, or use your master password.

BIO_UNLOCK_FAILED.text: Couldn't unlock with your device — unlock with your master password.

BIO_UNSUPPORTED.text: This device can't do biometric quick unlock — set up a PIN instead.

CANT_TELL_SERVER.text: andvari can’t tell which server to open right now — close this window and try again.

CARD_CHIP_LABEL.text: Fill card with andvari. Press Alt plus Down Arrow to open andvari.

CARD_CHIP_LOCKED.text: andvari is locked — click the andvari toolbar icon

CARD_CHIP_LOCKED_LABEL.text: andvari is locked — click the andvari toolbar icon. Press Alt plus Down Arrow to open andvari.

CARD_CLOSED_FORM.text: This payment form keeps its fields where andvari can't tell which one you tapped, so nothing was filled. Fill it by hand.

CARD_COPY_FAILED.text: Could not copy from this card — reopen the popup and try again.

CARD_COPY_IN_APP.text: Copy what you need from the andvari app.

CARD_COPY_MISSING_IN_APP.text: Copy what's missing from the andvari app.

CARD_DUPLICATE_FIELDS.text: This page shows more than one payment form asking for the same card detail, so andvari fills none of them.

CARD_FILL_FROM_APP.text: andvari fills no cards here: copy a card's number and code in the andvari app.

CARD_FILL_OFF_COPY.text: This build of andvari fills no cards into pages: copy a card's details with the buttons below.

CARD_FORM_CHANGED.text: The payment form changed after andvari opened. Open andvari again and fill.

CARD_MIXED_FORMS.text: You tapped card fields in two different payment forms; tap the one you want to pay with, then Fill.

CARD_NOT_VISIBLE.text: The card field you tapped can't be seen on the page, so nothing was filled. Scroll to the form and try again, or fill it by hand.

CARD_NO_FIELDS.text: Couldn't fill the card fields on this page.

CARD_NO_FOCUS.text: Tap the card field in the payment form first, then fill again.

CARD_NO_FORM.text: The payment form changed — tap its card field and try again.

CARD_NO_FRAME_ORIGIN.text: This browser doesn't tell andvari which site a payment form's frame comes from, so andvari fills no card into one. Update the browser to fill cards here.

CARD_PAGE_FORM.text: andvari fills a card only into a payment provider's card form, and this page takes the card itself.

CARD_PROVIDER_NOT_ALLOWED.text: The card form comes from {0}, where andvari isn't allowed to run. To fill it, allow andvari on {0} in the extension's site access.

CARD_PROVIDER_NOT_ALLOWED_ANY.text: andvari isn't running on this page, so it can't fill a card here. To let it, allow andvari on all sites in the extension's site access.

CARD_PROVIDER_NOT_ALLOWED_ANY_SAFARI.text: andvari isn't running on this page, so it can't fill a card here. To let it, allow andvari on Every Website in Safari's extension settings.

CARD_PROVIDER_NOT_ALLOWED_SAFARI.text: The card form comes from {0}, where Safari doesn't let andvari run yet. To fill it, allow andvari on {0} or on Every Website in Safari's extension settings.

CLIPBOARD_FAILED.text: Couldn't copy to the clipboard — try again.

CONNECTED_TO.text: Connected to {0}. Sign in from the toolbar popup.

CONNECTOR_CANCELLED.text: Cancelled — you can close this window and try again.

CONNECTOR_DONE.text: Done — you can close this window and reopen andvari.

CONNECTOR_NOTHING_TO_DO.text: Nothing to do here — you can close this window.

CONNECTOR_NO_BIO.text: This device can’t do biometric quick unlock. Use a PIN instead.

CONNECTOR_SET_UP.text: Set up unlocking with your device’s biometrics or PIN.

CONNECTOR_UNLOCK.text: Confirm it’s you to unlock andvari.

COPIED_CLEARS_SOON.text: Copied — it clears from your clipboard soon

DEVICE_QUICK_UNLOCK_ON.text: Device quick unlock is on for this browser.

ENROLL_BIO_FAILED.text: Couldn't turn on device quick unlock — try again.

ENROLL_FAILED.text: Couldn't turn on quick unlock — try again.

ENROLL_LOCKED.text: Unlock andvari first to set up quick unlock.

ENROLL_MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD.text: Set a new master password in the web vault before turning on quick unlock.

ENROLL_NEED_FULL_UNLOCK.text: Enter your master password once more to set up quick unlock.

ENTER_ALL_DIGITS.text: Enter all 6 digits of the code.

FILL_LOCKED.text: andvari locked before it could fill — unlock and try again.

FILL_NOT_ALLOWED.text: andvari wouldn't release this login for this page — try again from the popup.

FILL_NO_FIELDS.text: Couldn't fill the fields on this page — copy the username and password instead.

FILL_NO_FORM.text: No login fields found on this page — copy the username and password instead.

FILL_NO_SECRET.text: Nothing to fill — this login has no username or password saved.

FILL_OTHER_SITE.text: This login is saved for {0}. You are on {1}. Fill it here only if you trust this page.

FILL_THIS_PAGE_TITLE.text: Type this login into the current tab

FILL_UNREACHABLE.text: Couldn't reach the page — reload the tab and retry.

IDENTITY_MISMATCH.text: Server identity key mismatch — possible tampering. Do not proceed; contact your admin.

KDF_POLICY_BLOCKED.text: This server sent weakened security settings for your master password. Sign-in was blocked to protect you — contact your admin.

MENU_COVERED.text: Something on this page is covering andvari — use the andvari toolbar icon instead

MENU_LOCKED.text: Locked — click the andvari toolbar icon to unlock

MENU_LOCKED_ANNOUNCE.text: andvari is locked — click the andvari toolbar icon to unlock

MENU_NO_LOGIN_ANNOUNCE.text: No saved login for {0}, arrows to browse

MENU_UNCONFIRMED.text: This browser can't confirm andvari's menu is unobstructed — use the andvari toolbar icon instead

NO_PERSONAL_VAULT_CONFIRM.text: Open andvari to confirm your personal vault.

OPEN_APP_AND_UNLOCK.text: Open andvari and unlock it, then try again.

OPEN_FROM_TOOLBAR_TO_FILL_CARD.text: Open andvari from the toolbar to fill this card

OPTIONS_SERVER_NOT_ANSWERING.text: unknown — andvari isn't answering. Close this page and open it again.

OPTIONS_SERVER_UNSETTLED.text: unknown — andvari couldn't load its settings, so it signs in nowhere. Close this page and open it again in a minute.

PIN_DIGITS_NEED_LENGTH.text: An all-number PIN needs at least 10 digits — or add a letter to a shorter one.

PIN_EXHAUSTED.text: Too many wrong PINs — quick unlock is off. Unlock with your master password.

PIN_TOO_SHORT.text: Use at least 6 characters for your PIN.

PIN_TRIVIAL.text: That PIN is too easy to guess — avoid sequences and repeats.

PIN_UNLOCK_FAILED.text: Couldn't quick-unlock — unlock with your master password.

PURGE_DONE.text: Removed this browser's stored data for {0}.

PURGE_NOT_ANSWERING.text: andvari isn't answering, so nothing was removed. Close this page and open it again.

QUICK_UNLOCK_EXPIRED.text: It's been a while since you signed in — enter your master password to continue.

QUICK_UNLOCK_ON_HERE.text: Quick unlock is on for this browser.

QUICK_UNLOCK_SERVER_ERROR.text: The server had a problem answering — try again in a moment.

QUICK_UNLOCK_SESSION_ENDED.text: Your session ended — sign in again with your master password.

QUICK_UNLOCK_SET_UP_AGAIN.text: Quick unlock needs to be set up again — unlock with your master password.

QUICK_UNLOCK_UNAVAILABLE.text: Quick unlock isn't available in this browser mode — andvari has no private storage here to keep it in (Firefox does this when it never remembers history).

REUSED_MANY.text: The password you just typed on this page is already used for {0} other logins — a unique one is safer.

REUSED_ONE.text: The password you just typed on this page is already used for another login — a unique one is safer.

REVEAL_FAILED.text: Could not release that login — try again.

REVEAL_LOCKED.text: andvari locked before it could release that login — unlock and try again.

REVEAL_NOT_ALLOWED.text: andvari wouldn't release that login — reopen the popup and try again.

SAVE_APP_NO_ACCOUNT.text: Could not save — open the andvari app and sign in first.

SAVE_APP_UNAVAILABLE.text: Could not save — open the andvari app, then try again.

SAVE_CONFLICT_KEPT_BOTH.text: Saved — this login also changed elsewhere; both versions are in your vault.

SAVE_LOCKED.text: Could not save — unlock andvari and try again.

SAVE_REJECTED_ATTACHMENT.text: The server refused this save — an attachment it references is no longer there. Remove that attachment, then save again.

SAVE_SENT_TO_APP.text: Sent to andvari. Open the app to finish saving.

SAVE_UNLOCK_TOOLBAR.text: Open andvari from the toolbar and unlock to finish saving.

SEARCH_FROM_TOOLBAR.text: Click the andvari toolbar icon to search all your logins

SETTINGS_NOT_LOADED.text: It can’t tell which server you use right now, so it won’t sign in anywhere. Close this window and open it again in a minute.

SIGN_IN_SERVER_ERROR.text: The server had a problem answering — your details may be fine. Try again in a moment.

SIGN_OUT_CONFIRM.text: Sign out? Click again to confirm

SIGN_OUT_EXPLAINED.text: Signing out removes this browser's quick unlock (PIN or biometric) and its saved session. Your vault on the server is untouched.

TOO_MANY_WRONG_CODES.text: Too many wrong codes — sign in again.

TOTP_ADD_CONFLICT.text: One-time code added — this login also changed elsewhere; both versions are in your vault.

TOTP_ADD_EXISTS.text: This login already has a one-time code — manage it in the web vault.

TOTP_ADD_FAILED.text: Could not add the code — try again.

TOTP_ADD_INVALID.text: That doesn't look like a one-time-code secret — paste the otpauth:// link or the setup key.

TOTP_ADD_LOCKED.text: andvari locked before it could add the code — unlock and try again.

TOTP_ADD_NOT_ALLOWED.text: andvari couldn't tell which login this code belongs to — add it from the popup instead.

TOTP_ADD_READ_ONLY.text: This login is in a shared vault you can only view — ask its owner to add a one-time code.

TOTP_BAD_CODE.text: That code didn’t work — codes change every 30 seconds, so try the current one.

TOTP_ENTER_CODE.text: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

TOTP_EXPIRED.text: That took too long — sign in again.

TOTP_SECRET_LABEL.text: One-time code secret — paste the otpauth:// link or the setup key

TRUST_GATE_HTTP_CAUTION.text: This is a plain http:// address — traffic to it is not encrypted in transit.

TRUST_GATE_PUNYCODE_CAUTION.text: This address uses international characters, shown here in their punycode (xn--) form. Make sure it is exactly the server you intend.

UNREACHABLE.text: Can't reach the andvari server — check your connection (and your VPN, if your server is private), then try again.

UPDATE_LISTING_STALE.text: Updates: the server’s update listing hasn’t been re-signed in a while — if you’re expecting an update, mention it to your admin.

UPDATE_LISTING_UNVERIFIED.text: Updates: the server’s update listing couldn’t be verified, so no update will be offered from it. Your vault and sync are unaffected.

UPGRADE_REQUIRED.text: Your server requires a newer extension — get the update from the web vault or the link above.

WRONG_VAULT_LINE.text: The server sent an item under the wrong vault. andvari kept the item where it was and ignored the other copy. Tell your admin — the server may be misbehaving.
